name: Cross Mountain
generated_description:
At 4,170 feet, Cross Mountain is a summit in West Virginia. The Cross Mountain Trail covers 1.9 miles with about 147 feet of elevation gain — a gradual walk with modest climbing.

Getting There

The trailhead is at 38.00479, -80.53536 (tap for driving directions). It's roughly 60 miles northwest of Roanoke, Virginia. Arrive early on weekends — trailhead lots at popular peaks fill quickly, and cell service is often unreliable once you leave the highway.

When to Go

Late May through October is the main season. Snow and ice linger into spring and return early in fall at this latitude and elevation; in winter this becomes a different, more serious undertaking requiring traction devices and warm layers.

Know Before You Go

The Easy rating comes from the National Park Service difficulty formula, which weighs total distance against elevation gain. Most hikers should budget about 0.5 hours of moving time; add margin for breaks, photos and the descent. Download the GPX track from this page before you go — cell coverage is unreliable in the mountains and a saved route works offline in any GPS app. Conditions change: verify current access, closures and weather with the official land manager before you go. Trail data is sourced from OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

Looking to link objectives or plan a weekend? Nearby summits include Sugartree Bench Mountain, Spruce Mountain and Black Mountain — each has its own guide on this site.

faqs.answer: The Cross Mountain Trail is 1.9 miles with about 147 feet of elevation gain, and most hikers take roughly 0.5 hours of moving time. Add time for breaks and conditions — winter or wet weather can double the trip.

faqs.answer: It's rated Easy using the National Park Service difficulty formula (1.9 miles, 147 ft of gain — about 100 ft of climbing per mile). The elevation profile on this page shows exactly where the steep sections fall.

faqs.question: Where is the Cross Mountain trailhead?
faqs.answer: The trailhead is at 38.00479, -80.53536 in West Virginia. Use the driving-directions link in the Getting There section above, and note that parking at popular trailheads fills early on weekends.

faqs.question: Are dogs allowed on the Cross Mountain trail?
faqs.answer: Rules vary by land manager — national parks often prohibit dogs on trails, while most national forests allow them on leash. Check with the managing agency for this trail before bringing your dog, and pack out waste.

faqs.question: When is the best time to hike Cross Mountain?
faqs.answer: Late May through October for snow-free hiking. Check a summit point forecast before you go — conditions up high differ from the trailhead.

faqs.question: How tall is Cross Mountain?
faqs.answer: Cross Mountain stands at 4,170 feet (1,271 meters) in West Virginia.
